note: The entry follows Holmgren & Holmgren's 1915 original description (alate only); the original is a library OCR text of a BHL fascicle.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown; clypeal sclerite and mouthparts, pronotum, and the posterior half of the meso- and metanota pale greyish yellow-brown; anterior half of the meso- and metanota paler; dorsum of the abdomen brown, the venter straw-yellow with brown lateral spots; wings with a yellow 'subcostal stripe', smoke-coloured. Head and abdominal tergites densely hairy. Head broadly oval, narrowing anteriorly; compound eyes rather large; ocelli medium-sized, close against the compound eyes; fontanelle indistinct, the head depressed around it; clypeal sclerite far shorter than half its width, not strongly convex. Antennae 15-segmented: segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 about equal to segment 2. Pronotum narrower than the head, almost semicircular, anterior margin nearly straight, anterior angles strongly rounded, posterior margin distinctly concave; posterior margin of the mesonotum broader than that of the metanotum and more broadly and deeply concave. Media close to the cubitus, forked or with 3—4 apical branches; cubitus with about 10 rather long branches. Body length with wings 16 mm, without wings 8.5 mm; fore wing length 13.1 mm, width 3.38 mm; head width 1.68 mm; pronotum width 1.36 mm, length 0.76 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The original explicitly records soldier and worker as unknown (Soldaten und Arbeiter unbekannt). Locality: Ambrym, New Hebrides, in the 6th month (June) of 1911.
